title: Elembio/elembio-multiomics-nf pipeline parameters
description: Element Biosciences AVITI24 multiomics secondary analysis: cytoprofiling, spatial FASTQ generation, 3-prime untargeted RNA counting, and SpatialData assembly

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

id.description: Optional run identifier. If not set: when run_dir matches .../runs/<instrument>/<run_id>/analysis/<analysis_id>/..., that run_id is used; otherwise the last path segment of run_dir.

run_overrides.title: Run Overrides
run_overrides.description: Optional file overrides for run-level inputs (manifests, panels). Geometric filters (tile/batch/segmentation) live under Shared Filters. Prefer shared tca_manifest_csv so bases2fastq and cells2stats receive the same TCA; per-tool overrides are advanced escape hatches.

run_manifest_csv.description: Override RunManifest.csv for bases2fastq (auto-detected from run_dir when unset).

tca_manifest_csv.description: Shared Target Cell Assignment manifest CSV (SpecializedTargeted / OPS). Fans out to both bases2fastq and cells2stats unless a per-tool override is set. Production runs should use one identical TCA for both tools.

c2s_tca_manifest_csv.description: Advanced: cells2stats-only TCA override. Prefer tca_manifest_csv so b2f and c2s stay identical.

c2s_run_manifest.description: Optional run manifest override for cells2stats (.csv or .json).

b2f_tca_manifest_csv.description: Advanced: bases2fastq-only TCA override (OPS / per-target FASTQ). Prefer tca_manifest_csv so b2f and c2s stay identical.

shared_filters.title: Shared Filters
shared_filters.description: Geometric and sample filters applied identically across bases2fastq, cells2stats, and build_spatialdata. File overrides (manifests, panels) live under Run Overrides.

tile.description: Tile regex pattern(s) -- drives b2f -i, c2s --tile, and build_spatialdata --tile-filter

segmentation_dir.description: Custom cell segmentation directory. Passed to cells2stats (and bases2fastq when supported).

analysis_region_dir.description: Custom AnalysisRegion directory override. Applied to build-spatialdata only (cells2stats continues to read {run_dir}/AnalysisRegion). Used by the overlap-aware stitcher; ignored on non-overlap runs.

ignore_samples.description: Sample names to exclude from processing

c2s_args.description: DEPRECATED: catch-all string appended to cells2stats CLI. Prefer overriding `withName: CELLS2STATS { ext.args = { ... } }` in a `-c custom.config` overlay; see conf/modules.config for the canonical closure. Will be removed in a future release.

c2s_skip_qc_report.description: Skip the Cell Painting qc_report.html that cells2stats analyze generates (--skip-qc-report, rc9+). Default true; the published report is produced by CELLS2STATS_GENERATE_QC_REPORT from the pipeline-built SpatialData archive.

c2s_tar_program_logs.description: Tar/gz the cells2stats Logs directory; when false, the directory is published as-is

c2s_publish_spatialdata.description: Publish the c2s-internal SpatialData/ directory under cells2stats/SpatialData/. Off by default — the canonical SpatialData store is built by BUILD_SPATIALDATA at spatialdata/{run_id}.zarr.

enable_c2s_viz.description: Run CELLS2STATS_SPATIALDATABUILD_VIZ (cells2stats visualize). Set false to skip.

enable_c2s_qc_report.description: Run CELLS2STATS_GENERATE_QC_REPORT (cells2stats generate_qc_report; external Cell Painting qc_report.html under cells2stats/qc/). Distinct from avsd_qc_enabled (internal run-quality-report).

c2s_targeted_transcriptome_min_query_len.description: Minimum query-length gate (bases) for targeted transcriptome alignments (--targeted-transcriptome-min-query-length). Minimum 12. When unset, no extra gate beyond the adapter trimmer.

c2s_targeted_transcriptome_mismatch_thre.description: Override targeted transcriptome mismatch threshold for all targets (--targeted-transcriptome-mismatch-threshold). Valid 0-10; default is min(readLength/9, 10).

c2s_targeted_transcriptome_min_insert_al.description: Minimum insert bases an alignment must cover for targeted transcriptome assignment (--targeted-transcriptome-min-insert-aligned). 0 disables; default 9.

c2s_generate_targeted_transcriptome_bams.description: Output concatenated BAM files from targeted transcriptome alignment (--generate-targeted-transcriptome-bams).

c2s_static_overlap_stitching.description: Use default stitching for overlapping-tile runs (--static-overlap-stitching).

c2s_disable_per_batch_background.description: Do not quantify/export per-batch background intensity features Bkg_RED/Bkg_GRN (--disable-per-batch-background).

c2s_process_imaging_targets.description: Reprocess _Raw projection tiles into corrected Projection/ TIFFs before analysis (--process-imaging-targets).

c2s_enable_illumination_correction.description: Force illumination correction on for every imaging target and enabled background during --process-imaging-targets (--enable-illumination-correction). Requires c2s_process_imaging_targets. Mutually exclusive with c2s_disable_illumination_correction. When both enable and disable are false, panel Analyses / RecipeValues decide per target.

c2s_disable_illumination_correction.description: Force illumination correction off for every target during --process-imaging-targets (--disable-illumination-correction). Requires c2s_process_imaging_targets. Mutually exclusive with c2s_enable_illumination_correction. When both enable and disable are false, panel Analyses / RecipeValues decide per target.

c2s_target_mismatch_threshold.description: Override OPS mismatch threshold for all target sites (--target-mismatch-threshold). Valid 0-4.

c2s_specialized_targeted_min_query_lengt.description: Minimum query-length gate for specialized targeted (OPS) alignments (--specialized-targeted-min-query-length). Minimum 12.

c2s_generate_specialized_targeted_bams.description: Output concatenated BAM files from specialized targeted (OPS) alignment (--generate-specialized-targeted-bams).

c2s_visualization_workers.description: Stage A scan / Stage B encode worker count for cells2stats visualize (--visualization-workers); defaults to task.cpus when unset. Requires cells2stats 1.4.0-rc12+.

c2s_viz_shape_smoothing_workers.description: Shape smoothing worker count for cells2stats visualize; defaults to max(1, 2*task.cpus/3) when unset. Requires cells2stats 1.4.0-rc12+.

b2f_args.description: DEPRECATED: catch-all string appended to bases2fastq CLI. Prefer overriding `withName: BASES2FASTQ { ext.args = { ... } }` in a `-c custom.config` overlay; see conf/modules.config for the canonical closure. Will be removed in a future release.

b2f_exclude_tile.description: Tile exclusion patterns (list). Auto-populated when include tiles are active.

b2f_include_tile.description: Tile inclusion patterns (list). Falls back to shared tile param if empty.

genome.description: Reference genome key. Selects the FASTA, STAR index and GENCODE GTF from igenomes_base. GRCh38 is the production genome; GRCh38_chr20 is a chromosome-20 smoke slice loaded only by the test profile.

genes_gtf.description: GENCODE gene annotation GTF on the same assembly as the genome (release 47 validated; 31 or later expected to run). Defaults to the genome's GTF; required with --igenomes_ignore.

fasta.description: Custom references only (requires --igenomes_ignore): reference genome FASTA.

igenomes_base.description: Base path of the reference layout. Defaults to the Element reference bucket (STAR 2.7 indexes and GENCODE GTF); point it at a mirror of that layout to avoid remote reads.

igenomes_ignore.description: Ignore the genome map and supply --fasta, --star_index and --genes_gtf together.

star_index.description: Custom references only (requires --igenomes_ignore): STAR index built with STAR 2.7.4a or later.

star_mode.description: Named STAR stringency for 3' STAR_ALIGN (RNA2counts star_mode). star_default is STAR native (MatchNmin 0, score/match 0.66/0.66, multimapping 5). relaxed is the pre-1.10.0 DiSS set (15 / 0.2 / 0.1, multimapping 10). Also -profile star_default / star_relaxed / …

star_outFilterMultimapNmax.description: Optional override for the selected star_mode outFilterMultimapNmax.

star_outSAMmultNmax.description: Optional override for the selected star_mode outSAMmultNmax.

star_outFilterMatchNmin.description: Optional override for the selected star_mode outFilterMatchNmin.

star_outFilterScoreMinOverLread.description: Optional override for the selected star_mode outFilterScoreMinOverLread.

star_outFilterMatchNminOverLread.description: Optional override for the selected star_mode outFilterMatchNminOverLread.

star_alignSJoverhangMin.description: Optional override for the selected star_mode alignSJoverhangMin.

star_chimSegmentMin.description: Optional override for the selected star_mode chimSegmentMin.

fastq2parquet.title: Fastq2Parquet (shared)
fastq2parquet.description: Shared parameters for all FASTQ2PARQUET subworkflows including assay type routing and QC.

fastq2parquet_3prime.title: Fastq2Parquet 3Prime
fastq2parquet_3prime.description: Parameters specific to the FASTQ2PARQUET_3PRIME subworkflow (three-prime untargeted).

f2p_3p_slop_5p_bp.description: gen-feature-bed: bp a feature is extended in the 5' direction into the CDS.

f2p_3p_slop_3p_bp.description: gen-feature-bed: bp a feature is extended downstream past the gene's 3' terminus (the 3'UTR end for UTR-having genes, the terminal-exon end for UTR-less genes).

f2p_3p_features.description: Feature tier groups emitted into the SAF (comma-separated) — the single source of truth for tier selection. Exon-union model: 3'UTR tiers + exon (catches UTR-less genes; synthetic dropped) + chrM umbrella. To count introns, add the tier: 'utr,exon,intron,chrm'.

f2p_3p_unique_only_tiers.description: Feature tiers counted unique-only — their simple multimappers are dropped — via diss-tools --unique-only-categories. Comma-separated; inert unless the tier is included.

f2p_3p_include_gene_types.description: Gene biotypes retained when building the SAF (comma-separated; requires the full GTF).

f2p_3p_exclude_gene_types.description: Gene biotypes excluded when building the SAF (comma-separated; empty = none).

f2p_3p_count_simple_multimapping_reads.description: Count reads multimapping within a single gene.

f2p_3p_rescue_gene_family.description: Enable HGNC gene-family rescue in the rank collapse (needs f2p_3p_hgnc_gene_groups).

f2p_3p_hgnc_gene_groups.description: Path to the HGNC gene-groups TSV used for family rescue.

f2p_3p_resolver_metrics.description: Emit the assignment-engine all-records aggregate metrics TSV.

f2p_3p_read_filter_enabled.description: Run + enforce the soft-clip read filter (removes softclip-failing reads from the count matrix). Default off = the step is skipped and the matrix is unchanged. Soft-clip only — base-quality PF is upstream in bases2fastq.

f2p_3p_read_filter_softclip_max.description: Max read_min_softclip (%) allowed to pass the soft-clip rule.

enable_identify_filtered_polonies.description: Run IDENTIFY_FILTERED_POLONIES + MERGE_POLONY_PARQUETS. When false, SPLIT still runs on the aligned-only parquet; BUILD never reads the combined well×batch file.

avsd_zip_spatialdata.description: Zip the spatialdata *.zarr directory; when false, only the .zarr directory is produced

avsd_dask_write_threads.description: Concurrent dask tasks during element writes (build-spatialdata --dask-write-threads). 1 = synchronous (lowest memory), 2 = single-chunk read-ahead (recommended for single-well runs), N = up to N chunks in flight; diminishing returns above 3-4. Total concurrent threads ~= workers * dask_write_threads.

avsd_per_worker_lib_threads.description: OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL/NumExpr threads per BUILD_SPATIALDATA worker process. Same role as onboard kAggregationPythonPerWorkerLibThreads: keep Phase 1 OS threads ~= workers * this value instead of workers * host cpu_count. POLARS_MAX_THREADS is set to task.cpus (worker count), not this value.

avsd_debug_preserve_inputs.description: On BUILD_SPATIALDATA failure, tar+gzip-compress the staged input tree (polonies/, genes/, c2s_dir/, c2s_metrics/, b2f_dir/, f2p_3p_dir/, run_id/) into debug_inputs.tar.gz in the task work dir. Off by default; enable when triaging a reproducible failure to recover all inputs without rebuilding upstream.

avsd_fail_on_missing_batches.description: Pass --fail-on-missing-batches to build-spatialdata. When true, raise if a Panel-declared count batch (ThreePrime / OPS / barcoding / targeted transcriptome) has no points parquets at all. Present-but-unaligned batches (parquets exist, no target_name) are unaffected. Default false: warn, record under global-table-metadata.uns['missing_batches'], and continue.

spatialdata_qc.title: SpatialData QC Report
spatialdata_qc.description: Parameters for the SPATIALDATA_QC_REPORT process (elembio-spatialdata-analysis run-quality-report CLI).

avsd_qc_enabled.description: Master on/off for SPATIALDATA_QC_REPORT (run-quality report). Default false; requires spatialdata_analysis_container_url/_tag. Distinct from enable_c2s_qc_report (cells2stats generate_qc_report).

avsd_qc_run_analysis.description: Adds the Analysis tab (cell_state + sample_correlation + rarefaction + gene_distribution). CPU-only.

avsd_qc_run_embedding.description: Runs the per-modality HVG + PCA + UMAP embedding section. Multi-minute on CPU; reserved for a future GPU profile.

avsd_qc_advanced_metrics.description: Show ADV-tagged power-user sections (per-tile flowcell maps, base composition, rarefaction, feature distribution, cell-cycle, etc.).

avsd_qc_show_filter_tabs.description: Render Filtered sub-tabs alongside the Raw sub-tabs for each modality.

avsd_qc_args.description: Free-form extra args appended to the run-quality-report invocation.

docker_containers.title: Docker Containers
docker_containers.description: Docker container image URLs and version tags for pipeline modules.

infrastructure.description: Resource limits and pipeline infrastructure settings.
